items.q: Why is a slightly out-of-tune 陶喆 a compliment?
items.a: [[live-unassisted-as-compliment]]. Live. No track holding him. She would rather take imperfect than the thought it was helped.

items.q: What is working harder than the voice in the late clip?
items.a: The body. Skills are obvious. Riffs and landings are not. Spaces he could fill with runs stay empty.

items.q: What does reverse-chrono do that a bio cannot?
items.a: [[same-song-years-apart]]. She is not briefed. She hears one dude get younger. 小镇姑娘 twice is the x-ray.
[[falsetto-on-purpose-not-failure]]. Art, emotion, color. Illegal when the thick place failed and he had to flip.

items.q: What is a voice made of?
items.a: [[voice-is-tissue]]. Blood, mucus, muscle. Water / no-scream / sleep delay the loss. Years still catch up. Touring makes the care hard.

items.q: What did she do to Beyoncé *Listen* that ego hates?
items.a: [[lower-the-key-serve-the-song]]. One semitone. Room cannot hear it. Two or three takes stay bold. Serve the song, not the old key.
